instructions.text: Conduct inspections at start of shift, checking that all listed areas are clean and in good, functioning condition, and that equipment/machinery is in a good state of repair and intact. Detail any non-conformance in the Comments column. Key: Y = Inspected and in order, N = Inspected but not conforming.
instructions.label: Work instruction

roster.title: Equipment checks — covers Conveyors/Seamer, Washing machines/tumblers, Retort 1&2, Steamer, Boiler room, Can Drier, tanks (sea/fresh water), Compressor, Cooling system, Effluent water, Live area seawater tank, Sewage, etc.
